label: 原退款读者申请同专栏恢复
description: 免费恢复请求（request.restore）与订阅合同（contract.subscription）的读者和专栏一致，存在请求前已到账的恢复所需退款证明（role.restore-refund），并存在请求前形成的同版本重新上架记录（evidence.relaunch）时，允许申请免费恢复。
expression:
request.subscription_id == agreement.subscription_id &&
request.reader_id == agreement.reader_id && request.column_id ==
agreement.column_id && refunds.exists(p, p.subscription_id ==
request.subscription_id && p.reader_id == request.reader_id &&
p.column_id == request.column_id && p.settled &&
p.amount_minor_units == agreement.amount_minor_units && p.currency
== agreement.currency && p.confirmed_at <= request.started_at) &&
notices.exists(n, n.subscription_id == request.subscription_id &&
n.reader_id == request.reader_id && n.column_id == request.column_id
&& n.edition_id == request.edition_id && n.listed && n.relaunched_at
<= n.created_at && n.created_at <= request.started_at)
